_comment: Copy to rules.json. Rules are matched against the lowercased transaction title plus counterpart name. Order: patterns (by priority), then merchant_map, then keywords; first hit wins. Anything unmatched goes to the LLM, or to CHECK ME when no LLM is configured — and every correction you make in the app teaches a new rule back into this file. Starting nearly empty is fine.
_comment_keywords: Plain substring → category. Category names must exist in your app, or they are dropped.
_comment_merchant_map: Same as keywords, kept separate so merchant names stay readable.
_comment_patterns: Checked before the maps, highest priority first. Use for phrases that would otherwise be caught by a shorter keyword.
